title: The Stage Blocks
youtube_title: The Stage Blocks | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is letting each person keep the part they do best.
summary: At a bakery kitchen before the early table, a three stage blocks that made a step only if aligned will go wrong if one person rushes. Remy and Kito split it into two slow jobs, while Ms. Okonkwo only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
